A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Carpathian geosyncinal basin was filled by sediments in a cyclic way, each cycle beginning with coarse deposits, and terminating with finer-grained sediments.
the flysch deposits were supplied in several sedimentation megarhythms.
the Carpathian flysch is a product of a geosyncline that was formed in the course of the Alpine orogeny.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current direction is not the same as the direction of the source of sediments.
the sedimentation of the flysch in the Polish Carpathians was controlled by the movements in the subcrust.
